notes.title: Update 1.3 – Story & Fixes
notes.content:
Undergoes - Update 1.3

Hey explorers,

Update 1.3 is here, packed with fixes, customization options, and a deeper look into the world of Undergoes. Here’s what’s new:

🎬 New Content

A brand new thematic cutscene has been added, revealing more of the story and setting the tone for what's ahead.

⚙️ Features & Settings

Added a motion blur toggle in the settings menu, turn it off or on based on your preference.

You can now reset your game saves from the settings if you want a fresh start  :D

Drillship customization is here! Choose from different color options to make your ship your own.

🐛 Bug Fixes

Fixed collision issues that were causing strange interactions with the environment.

Resolved bugs related to item duplication and broken crafting recipes.

We’re getting closer to something big, thanks for sticking with us and keep that feedback coming!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h1bf1OO_d.webp?maxwidth=760&fidelity=grand[/img]

notes.title: Undergoes Update 1.2 – Bug Fixes & Better Indications!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.2 is here, bringing a ton of improvements to Undergoes! We've fixed loads of bugs, added more indications to key areas like the library and similar objects, and improved navigation by making cave colors change when you enter them. Some unnecessary elements have been removed, and overall, the experience should feel much smoother.

We're still on the lookout for more bugs to fix and will also be adding a variety of new settings to enhance customization. But looking ahead, I’d love to hear from you all—should we focus on expanding the single-player experience, or would multiplayer be something the community is truly interested in?

Undergoes is a game I love, and I want you all to love it too. Your feedback means everything, so let me know your thoughts and ideas!

Thanks for playing!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zGKbgS1.png[/img]

notes.title: Undergoes Update 1.1 – March 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're thrilled to bring you Update 1.1 for Undergoes! This update focuses on improving gameplay engagement, introducing new content, and fixing bugs to ensure a smoother experience. Here’s what's new:

[b]New Features:[/b]
Objective System:
We’ve added a brand new Objective System! This system will help keep players focused and engaged by providing clear objectives that encourage constant exploration and survival. Now, you’ll always have a goal to work toward, whether it’s gathering resources, crafting, or discovering new areas.

[b]New Insect:[/b]
Say hello to a new insect in the world of Undergoes! This addition adds more variety to the dangerous ecosystem and brings new challenges as you explore the apocalyptic world.

[b]New Structures to Explore:[/b]
The world of Undergoes is now even more immersive with the addition of new structures scattered throughout the environment. These locations are packed with hidden secrets, valuable resources, and unexpected surprises for players to discover.

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
Tons of bug fixes have been implemented to address issues that were affecting gameplay stability.
General performance optimizations to make the game run more smoothly on all systems.
We hope this update makes your journey through Undergoes even more exciting! As always, keep your feedback coming—we’re committed to making the game the best it can be.

Thank you for your continued support,
The Undergoes Team
